headline: Added an Implementation Consulting built-in pillar — the second parallel non-trades track alongside Design Systems. Generalist software-implementation / onboarding / professional-services roles (10 title-search terms, 6 ATS role terms), remote+Spokane, experienced (drops the entry-level clause). New curated `ic-brief` "Apply Now" group in jobsData.ts (9 tiles: remote + Spokane live searches on LinkedIn/Indeed/Google Jobs + Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workday hidden-jobs dorks). DiscoverView now derives the ATS Location default 'both' when a pillar's location names both Remote and Spokane (AtsPanel already supported 'both'). BUILTIN_PILLARS is now 5; pillars.test.ts + pillarStore.test.ts updated (importStarter/appNav counts are dynamic/unrelated). Typecheck + build + affected tests green; verified the pillar, Apply Now tiles, and the Both ATS default render at desktop + 390px.
